A connecting device (6) is provided for interconnecting a windscreen wiper device (1) of the flat blade type and an oscillating arm (7) pivotally connectable to the connecting device about a pivot axis near one end thereof. The windscreen wiper device includes an elastic, elongated carrier element, as well as an elongated wiper blade (2) of a flexible material, which can be placed in abutment with a windscreen to be wiped. The wiper blade includes at least one groove (3), in which groove a longitudinal strip (4) of the carrier element is disposed. The connecting device is arranged to be connected to the longitudinal strip, and includes—at least one hole (19) of a first type arranged to allow a welding tool access through the hole of the first type to contact the longitudinal strip for welding the longitudinal strip and the connecting device together; and—at least one hole (20) of a second type arranged to allow a pin access through the hole of the second type and through the longitudinal strip for interconnecting the longitudinal strip and the connecting device.

outputs.L3:
A connecting device is provided for interconnecting a flat blade windscreen wiper device with an oscillating wiper arm, wherein the oscillating arm is arranged to pivot near one end of the windscreen wiper device. The connecting device enables the wiper arm to be securely coupled to the wiper device while allowing the wiping movement required during operation.

The windscreen wiper device comprises an elastic, elongated carrier element and a flexible, elongated wiper blade configured to contact and wipe the surface of a windscreen. The carrier element provides structural support and resilience to the wiper blade, helping the blade maintain an appropriate wiping pressure along its length. The flexible wiper blade is shaped to conform to the curvature of the windscreen during use.

The wiper blade is provided with at least one longitudinal groove. A longitudinal strip forming part of the carrier element is received within this groove, thereby supporting the wiper blade along its length. The engagement between the groove and the longitudinal strip assists in retaining the blade in position and contributes to the overall stiffness and flexibility characteristics of the flat blade wiper device.

The connecting device is arranged to be connected to the longitudinal strip of the carrier element. By connecting directly to the longitudinal strip, the connecting device forms a reliable mechanical interface between the carrier element of the wiper device and the oscillating wiper arm. This arrangement helps transfer forces from the wiper arm to the wiper blade during wiping operation.

The connecting device includes different types of holes serving different functions. A first type of hole is provided to allow welding access, enabling welding equipment or welding energy to reach a portion of the connecting device or the longitudinal strip during assembly. A second type of hole is provided for pin-based interconnection with the longitudinal strip of the carrier element. This second type of hole is configured to receive or cooperate with a pin, projection, or similar fastening element so that the connecting device can be mechanically secured to the longitudinal strip. Together, these features allow the connecting device to be attached in a robust and reliable manner while facilitating efficient manufacture and assembly of the windscreen wiper device.
outputs.L4:
A connecting device is provided for joining a flat-blade windscreen wiper to an oscillating wiper arm. The device is designed to be mounted on the longitudinal carrier strip of the wiper blade, which forms part of the structural support of the flat-blade assembly. In use, the connecting device acts as an interface between the wiper blade and the drive arm, allowing the blade to be securely attached while still permitting the movement required during wiping operation.

The carrier strip is formed with dedicated access holes that cooperate with corresponding parts of the connecting device. These holes make it possible to position and fasten the device accurately on the wiper blade. A first type of hole is provided for welded attachment, allowing portions of the connecting device to be secured directly to the carrier strip by welding. This creates a strong and permanent connection that helps maintain the correct alignment of the wiper components under repeated operating loads.

A second type of hole is provided separately for pin-based interconnection. These holes allow pins or similar fastening elements to pass through or engage with the carrier strip and the connecting device, thereby mechanically locking the parts together. The use of dedicated pin-receiving holes enables an additional or alternative attachment method, depending on the required construction of the wiper assembly.

By incorporating separate hole types for welding and pin engagement, the connecting device offers improved versatility in manufacturing and assembly. It can be adapted to different production methods and design requirements while maintaining a secure connection between the flat-blade wiper and the oscillating arm. This arrangement improves the stability of the wiper structure, supports reliable operation during wiping, and facilitates a robust connection between the blade carrier and the arm connector.

**The Power of “The”**

“The” is one of the most common and important words in the English language. Although it is small, it plays a big role in making sentences clear and specific. It is called the definite article because it points to a particular person, place, thing, or idea.

For example, there is a difference between saying “I saw a dog” and “I saw the dog.” The first sentence could mean any dog, but the second sentence refers to a specific dog that the speaker and listener may already know about. In this way, “the” helps create meaning and context.

The word “the” appears in everyday speech, books, newspapers, songs, and conversations. It is often used without much thought, but it quietly supports the structure of English. Without it, many sentences would sound incomplete or unclear.

Even though “the” is simple, it is essential. It shows how even the smallest words can have great importance in communication.

counterfactuals.output: A connecting device for a flat blade windscreen wiper is provided for securing a wiper blade assembly to a wiper arm. counterfactuals.prompt: Describe an invention for interconnecting a flat blade windshield wiper device with an oscillating wiper arm, including the blade groove, longitudinal strip, pivotable connector, and holes for welding and pin fastening.
counterfactuals.output:
The invention relates to an arrangement for interconnecting a flat blade windshield wiper device with an oscillating wiper arm.

The windshield wiper device comprises an elongated, flexible wiper blade made of an elastomeric material. The wiper blade includes a longitudinal groove extending along its length. A resilient longitudinal strip, for example a spring strip or carrier element, is received in this groove so that the strip supports the blade and distributes the wiping pressure over the length of the blade during operation.

A connecting device is mounted to the longitudinal strip for attachment to the oscillating wiper arm. The connecting device includes a connector that is pivotable relative to the wiper blade about a pivot axis extending substantially transverse to the longitudinal direction of the blade. This pivotability allows the wiper blade to follow the curvature of the windshield while the wiper arm oscillates.

The longitudinal strip and/or an associated mounting part is provided with holes for securing the connector assembly. In particular, at least one hole may be used for welding the connector or a base portion of the connector to the longitudinal strip, for example by spot welding through or at the hole. Additional holes may be provided for receiving fastening pins. These pins mechanically secure the connector or an intermediate connecting member to the longitudinal strip and ensure a stable, accurately positioned connection.

In one embodiment, the connector includes two opposing side walls arranged on either side of the longitudinal strip or of a mounting bracket fixed to the strip. The side walls are provided with aligned openings through which a pivot pin extends, thereby defining the pivot axis. The pivot pin permits the connector to pivot relative to the blade while remaining firmly attached to the wiper arm.

Thus, the invention provides a compact and reliable interconnection between a flat blade windshield wiper device and an oscillating wiper arm, using the blade groove and longitudinal strip for structural support, a pivotable connector for articulation, and holes arranged for welding and pin fastening to achieve a secure connection.

counterfactuals.prompt: Generate a European patent-style technical description of a connecting device for a flat blade wiper assembly connected to an oscillating arm near a pivot axis, with carrier element strips disposed in grooves of a flexible wiper blade.
counterfactuals.output:
**Technical Description**

The present invention relates to a connecting device for a windscreen wiper assembly, in particular for a flat blade wiper assembly intended to be connected to an oscillating wiper arm of a vehicle windscreen wiping system. More particularly, the invention concerns a connecting device arranged in the region of a pivot axis between the wiper assembly and the oscillating arm, wherein the wiper assembly comprises a flexible wiper blade provided with longitudinal grooves in which carrier element strips are disposed.

A flat blade wiper assembly of this type generally comprises an elongate wiping element made of an elastomeric material, such as natural or synthetic rubber. The wiping element includes a wiping lip for contacting a surface to be wiped, for example a vehicle windscreen. The wiping element further comprises opposed longitudinal grooves extending substantially along the length of the wiper blade. In these grooves there are received one or more longitudinal carrier element strips. The carrier element strips, also referred to as flexors or vertebrae, are made of a resilient material, for example spring steel or a reinforced plastics material, and serve to distribute the force applied by the oscillating wiper arm over substantially the entire length of the wiper blade.

The connecting device is provided for mechanically coupling the flat blade wiper assembly to the oscillating arm. The oscillating arm is arranged to perform a reciprocating angular movement about an arm drive axis, and the connection between the arm and the wiper assembly permits pivoting of the wiper assembly relative to the arm about a pivot axis extending substantially transversely to the longitudinal direction of the wiper blade. This pivoting allows the wiper blade to adapt its angular position to the curvature and inclination of the surface to be wiped during operation.

In one embodiment, the connecting device comprises a base part fixed to the carrier element strips. The base part may be mounted centrally on the wiper assembly or at another predetermined position along the longitudinal extent thereof. The base part may include retaining formations which engage the carrier element strips at least partially from above and/or laterally. In particular, the base part may comprise opposed claws, hooks or folded retaining portions which embrace the carrier element strips received in the grooves of the flexible wiper blade. The base part may thereby be secured to the carrier element strips without requiring direct fastening to the elastomeric wiper blade.

The base part may further comprise a support portion arranged above the flexible wiper blade. The support portion may include a transverse bearing member defining the pivot axis. The bearing member may be formed integrally with the base part or may be a separate pin, shaft or journal received in corresponding openings or bearing seats of the base part. The pivot axis preferably extends substantially perpendicular to the longitudinal axis of the wiper blade and substantially parallel to the plane defined by the carrier element strips.

The connecting device may further comprise a coupling part configured to cooperate with an end portion of the oscillating arm. The coupling part may be mounted pivotably on the base part about the pivot axis. In an embodiment, the coupling part comprises two spaced side walls provided with bearing openings or bearing surfaces which receive the transverse bearing member of the base part. Alternatively, the base part may comprise bearing openings and the coupling part may include outwardly projecting journals defining the pivot axis.

The coupling part may include an arm receiving region adapted to receive a free end of the oscillating arm. The arm receiving region may be configured for a hook-type arm, a side-pin arm, a bayonet arm, a top-lock arm or another standard arm end configuration. In an advantageous embodiment, the coupling part comprises locking means for releasably securing the oscillating arm to the connecting device. The locking means may include a resilient latch, a snap-fit tongue, a locking button, a detent projection or a spring-biased retaining element. Such locking means may cooperate with an aperture, recess, shoulder or edge of the oscillating arm.

The connecting device is preferably arranged such that the pivot axis is located close to the longitudinal centre plane of the wiper assembly and above the carrier element strips. This arrangement provides a compact coupling and allows efficient transmission of wiping pressure from the oscillating arm to the carrier element strips. Since the carrier element strips are received in the grooves of the flexible wiper blade, the force applied through the connecting device is transferred directly to the carrier structure of the blade and is distributed over the length of the blade by the resilient curvature of the strips.

In a further embodiment, the base part comprises a lower gripping section having first and second retaining legs arranged on opposite longitudinal sides of the wiper blade. Each retaining leg may engage an outer longitudinal edge of a respective carrier element strip. The retaining legs may be deformed, crimped or snapped into engagement with the strips. In another embodiment, the base part includes apertures or windows through which portions of the carrier element strips extend or are visible, thereby enabling a secure mechanical interlock.

The carrier element strips may be disposed in parallel grooves provided on opposite sides of an upper holding portion of the wiper blade. The grooves may open laterally outwardly, and the strips may be inserted longitudinally into the grooves. End caps may be mounted at opposite longitudinal ends of the wiper assembly to retain the carrier element strips in the grooves. The connecting device may be mounted between the end caps, preferably at a central position, and may prevent relative longitudinal movement between the carrier element strips and the flexible wiper blade at that location.

The base part may be made of metal, plastics material, or a combination thereof. For example, the base part may be manufactured as a stamped and bent metal component, preferably from stainless steel or coated steel, providing high strength and dimensional stability. The coupling part may be made of plastics material, for example by injection moulding, in order to permit formation of resilient locking elements and complex arm receiving geometries. Alternatively, both the base part and the coupling part may be formed of plastics material, optionally fibre-reinforced.

The connecting device may include means for limiting the pivoting movement between the wiper assembly and the oscillating arm. Such limiting means may comprise stop surfaces provided on the base part and the coupling part. The stop surfaces may define a maximum angular displacement in each pivot direction about the pivot axis. This prevents excessive rotation of the wiper assembly relative to the arm during mounting, operation or lifting of the arm away from the windscreen.

In use, the oscillating arm applies a downward force to the coupling part. This force is transmitted through the pivot connection to the base part and from the base part to the carrier element strips. The carrier element strips, being received in the longitudinal grooves of the flexible wiper blade, distribute the force along the blade so that the wiping lip is pressed substantially uniformly against the windscreen. During oscillation of the arm, the wiper assembly follows the surface to be wiped, while the pivot connection permits angular adaptation of the blade relative to the arm near the pivot axis.

The connecting device may further be provided with a cover or spoiler-compatible housing. The cover may shield the pivot connection from dirt, ice and moisture, and may improve aerodynamic behaviour of the wiper assembly. In embodiments in which the flat blade wiper assembly includes an aerodynamic spoiler extending along at least a portion of the wiper blade, the connecting device may be shaped to form a continuation of the spoiler profile or to be received between spoiler portions located on either side of the connecting device.

Assembly of the wiper assembly may be performed by inserting the carrier element strips into the longitudinal grooves of the flexible wiper blade, positioning the base part of the connecting device over the carrier element strips, and securing the base part by snap-fitting, crimping, welding, riveting or other mechanical engagement. The coupling part may then be mounted to the base part by inserting the bearing member into the corresponding bearing openings, or by snapping the coupling part onto the bearing member. The oscillating arm is subsequently connected to the coupling part and locked in place by the locking means.

The connecting device described herein provides a reliable connection between a flat blade wiper assembly and an oscillating arm while maintaining the ability of the wiper assembly to pivot near the pivot axis. By engaging the carrier element strips disposed in the grooves of the flexible wiper blade, the connecting device permits effective transmission and distribution of wiping pressure without impairing the flexibility of the wiping element. The device is compact, suitable for automated assembly and adaptable to different types of wiper arm end portions.
